title: The hoarse Dublin United Tramway Company’s timekeeper bawled them off
html_source: Timekeepers would be enlightening the public who wish to access the Tramway when the trams are coming by shouting out the locations which are arriving for pickup. This would make his voice hoarse from yelling/“bawling”.
